card.name: Digits inside dates and section numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit, mostly 2 (also 1 or 7), inside a number code. It sits in the middle of a date, section number, DOI or table of figures, with separators like - . / around it.

modes.label: Digit in a date
modes.description: The digit 2 in the day or month slot of a dashed or slashed date.

modes.label: Digit in section or reference code
modes.description: A digit within a section number, DOI or catalogue number.
